name: ringtones
description: Short synthesized chimes when a long turn finishes, a call is blocked, a turn fails or you ship

isMuted.title: Mute
isMuted.description: Silence every ringtone without uninstalling the mod.

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Linear gain from 0 to 4. 1 is the recorded level.

minTurnSeconds.title: Shortest turn that chimes
minTurnSeconds.description: Only turns at least this long play the done chime, so quick answers stay quiet.
